title: The Appropriation Act, 2003
text:
Legal Supplement Part A to the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette’’, Vol. 41,
No. 206, 31st October, 2002
First Session Eighth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 1 of 2002
[L.S.]
AN ACT to provide for the Service of Trinidad and
Tobago for the financial year ending on the
30th day of September, 2003.
[Assented to 31st October, 2002]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
Enactment
follows:—
1. This Act may be cited as the Appropriation Act,Short title
2003.

2 No. 1 Appropriation 2002
Issue from the 2. (1) The issue from the Consolidated Fund of the
Consolidated Fund
authorised sum of thirteen thousand, three hundred and ninety-six
million, four hundred and sixteen thousand, one
hundred and seventy-five dollars is hereby authorised
for meeting expenditure for the service of the financial
year ending 30th September, 2003 under the Heads of
Expenditure specified in the Schedule.
(2) The sum specified in the Schedule opposite to
each Head is hereby appropriated out of the said sum of
thirteen thousand, three hundred and ninety-six
million, four hundred and sixteen thousand, one
hundred and seventy-five dollars for the purpose
specified in relation to that Head in the Estimates of
Expenditure for the financial year ending
30th September, 2003.
3. This Act shall come into force on the 1st day of
Commencement
October, 2002.
